tools.name: overview
tools.description: The CKB ecosystem over the last day, week or month: how many updates, people and projects, the most active projects, people and organisations, and the projects new to Pulse.

tools.name: find_projects
tools.description: Search the projects Pulse follows by words in their name, description or topics, by area (ckb, fiber, dob/spore, rgb++, ccc, nervos), or both; the most active first.

tools.name: project
tools.description: One followed project in detail: description, language, topics, activity per day over 30 days, commits and developers per month, its people and its latest updates.

tools.name: person
tools.description: What one person works on across the CKB projects Pulse follows: their projects, the areas and languages of those projects, and the kinds of updates they make.

tools.name: who_works_on
tools.description: The people most active in the projects of an area (ckb, fiber, dob/spore, rgb++, ccc, nervos) or in the projects that match some words, with the projects they work on. Useful to find who to ask about a part of CKB.

tools.name: recent_updates
tools.description: The latest updates by people (pushes, pull requests, issues, reviews, releases) across CKB, or in one project, or by one person; newest first.

tools.name: dao_funded
tools.description: The projects the Nervos Community Fund DAO pays for: their code activity next to their reports on Nervos Talk, and whether each is in progress, quiet or delivered.

tools.name: trends
tools.description: Developers, new developers and commits per month over two years, in the projects Pulse follows today. The current month is so far.
